messages:
sarah-csops: Morning — noticed overnight job set ~4.2k accounts to 'at-risk' because contact_count came in as 0 after the vendor import.

maria-success: ugh. which import? the weekly enrichment? :grimacing:

sarah-csops: Yes, vendor_enrich_2026-03-20. looks like contacts array got nulled for rows where email_verified=false. triggers the healthscore rule: `if contact_count < 1 => risk++`

jon-devex: @sarah-csops can you paste the query that computes contact_count? I want to see if it's using `coalesce(array_length(...),0)` or something brittle.

sarah-csops: here — quick snippet:
```
SELECT account_id, array_length(contacts) as contact_count
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE import_batch = 'vendor_enrich_2026-03-20';
```
It returns NULL for some rows.

andy-eng: SQL fix: use `coalesce(array_length(contacts),0)` — but we should also check the import transform. I'll open a PR for the pipeline.

jon-devex: For now we can silence the playbook automation on this batch to avoid a wave of unnecessary outreach. Add a temporary mute tag for `import:vendor_enrich_2026-03-20` in the playbook router.

sarah-csops: Good call. @playbook-bot do we have an API to mute by import tag? 

playbook-bot: yes — endpoint `POST /playbook/mute` accepts json { "predicate": "import:vendor_enrich_2026-03-20", "until": "2026-03-22T12:00:00Z" }

maria-success: I can run that. also want to capture a sample of affected accounts for manual review — can we generate a CSV and share in the enablement folder?

jon-devex: I'll add a temporary dashboard filter `import_batch` and a sample query. also adding an alert to ops-monitor to notify when contact_count NULL% > 0.5% next run.

ops-monitor-bot: alert created: `crm.contact_count_null_rate` threshold 0.005. will post to #eng-oncall and #customer-success.

andy-eng: PR opened: infra/imports#312 — adds coalesce fallback and logs rows with empty contacts. want everyone to review. planning rollback window at 11:30 UTC if anything breaks.

sarah-csops: Thanks team. Plan: (1) mute playbook for that import, (2) run SQL backfill: `UPDATE crm.accounts SET contacts = '{}' WHERE contacts IS NULL AND import_batch='vendor_enrich_2026-03-20'`, (3) re-enable playbook and run a dry-run. I'll coordinate with enablement for outreach template changes.

maria-success: ping me when dry-run is ready — I'll validate samples and update playbook message templates to avoid alarming customers.

jon-devex: leaving a short runbook note in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/csops/import-backfill-runbook

sarah-csops: closing loop — will post final outcome here when done. :thumbsup:
